parse_protobuf_text_to_message: parse a protobuf text format string into a protobuf message using text_format.Parse
merge_protobuf_text_into_message: merge protobuf text format into an existing message using text_format.Merge to update fields
print_message_to_text_string: convert a protobuf message to a human-readable text format string using text_format.MessageToString
print_message_with_options: print a protobuf message as one-line or with short repeated primitives using MessageToString options
tokenize_protobuf_text: tokenize protobuf text format input using text_format.Tokenizer to parse identifiers, strings, and integers
